messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: sampling from gamma
parts:
Hi,

For some reason sampling from gamma (u~gamma(0.001, 0.001) gives the following error:
Error :

Initialization between (-2, 2) failed after 100 attempts.
 Try specifying initial values, reducing ranges of constrained values, or reparameterizing the model.

The same error occurs with any parameter values to gamma.

However, when the sampling statement is commented out the error is not thrown.

Is gamma not functioning correctly? Is there a work around?

Thank you,
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] sampling from gamma
parts:
The problem is this:

parameters {
vector [N] u;
...
model {
u ~ gamma (0.001, 0.001);
...

You need to constrain the variable u to be positive because
gamma() only has support on (0,inf).

And following Andrew, I'll beep at the extra spaces
before "[" and "(". It makes the programs hard to read
because it violates standard formatting conventions. To me,
i t i s l i k e w r i t i n g t e x t l i k e t h i s .

We seem to get a lot of creative spacing from users in Stan,
some of it derived from R's unusual conventions, such as

return(x) vs. return x

if(foo) vs. if (foo)

line breaks to denote ends of statements vs. semicolons

I find the ones on the left hard to read --- every other language
I know conventionally uses the forms on the right (other than
Python, which uses spaces and line breaks; Lisp and its descendants
where it's all parens, and make, which uses tabs).

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] sampling from gamma
parts:
I should've added that this is largely our fault for not
supplying error messages for initialization errors (either
user-supplied or random). I thought that got fixed, but
apparently not, as of RStan 2.6, which has:

> fit <- stan(model_code="parameters { vector[100] u; } model { u ~ gamma(1,1); }")

TRANSLATING MODEL 'anon_model' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'anon_model' NOW.

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'anon_model' NOW (CHAIN 1).

Error :

Initialization between (-2, 2) failed after 100 attempts.
Try specifying initial values, reducing ranges of constrained values, or reparameterizing the model.

error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done


I've opened an issue in Stan, which is where the errors should
come from:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1326

- Bob
